fonts: next/font/google Beth_Ellen (400) and Montserrat (400, 600, 700) in src/app/layout.tsx; this system loads both from Google Fonts

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page: cream paper with `paper-grain.svg` laid over it (body, every page). Text on it is `ink` (10.6:1), `blue-deep` (8.6:1), `lavender-ink` (6.1:1) or `coral-action` (5.0:1). Also the text on the blue hero and footer (8.6:1 on `blue-deep`).

tokens.name: paper-light
tokens.usage: Raised cream: what sits on a sheet to be pressed or read (a free day, a time, the next lesson, a field, a dialog's inner card) and the text on coral and blue buttons (5.4:1 on `coral-action`, 9.3:1 on `blue-deep`). Never an outline of its own.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The booking and schedule name for `paper-light`: a day, a time, a lesson card, a control's track, a student's card rows. Write `raised` inside booking and Inês's schedule, `paper-light` elsewhere.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Every card and dialog: `lavender` laid thinly over the paper (#ebe3db on `paper`), so the grain shows through. Dan chose it back over solid lilac. `ink` reads 9.8:1 on it, `lavender-ink` 5.7:1, `coral-action` 4.6:1; `coral` never (2.6:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: The lilac of the splats: marks, the second line of the home title on blue (4.4:1, display size only), rules under headings, a chosen chip's edge, the hover edge on list rows. Never body text on cream (1.95:1).

tokens.name: lavender-soft
tokens.usage: The lilac button's fill (`ink` on it 9:1), a track behind a segmented control on blue, light text on the blue booking panel (7.3:1 on `blue-deep`).

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Quiet text on cream and on sheets: eyebrows, legends, a card's second line, links in the sign-in card, a principle's script heading. 6.1:1 on `paper`, 6.6:1 on `paper-light`, 5.7:1 on `sheet`. Deepened so 'I've forgotten my password' clears AA on the sign-in card.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: The one brand blue: the home hero, the booking intro panel, the footer, the header's Booking pill, the blue button, chosen days and times, the segmented thumb, the timetable's today line. `paper` or `paper-light` on it (8.6 to 9.3:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Alias of `blue-deep`: the stylesheet writes `--blue` where it means the brand blue on a surface (a chosen state, an inset edge).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Legacy name, kept because the stylesheet still writes it (the hero's ground, the approach page's rule). It is the brand blue; never introduce green, and write `blue` in new work.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Legacy name for `blue-deep`, used by three rules (the wordmark's ink and two headings). Write `blue-deep` in new work.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text and headings on cream, sheets and lilac: a shade deeper than `blue-deep`, which read 4.42:1 on the lavender panels. 10.6:1 on `paper`, 9.8:1 on `sheet`, 9:1 on `lavender-soft`, 5.4:1 on `lavender`. Also the blue button's hover fill.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Booking's colour as paint, not text: splats, a booked lesson's dot and edge, the selected-day ring, a lesson's 'Booked' wash, the FAQ dab. 2.8:1 on `paper`, so never words on cream; words in coral are `coral-action`.

tokens.name: coral-action
tokens.usage: The coral that carries words and actions: the coral button's fill (`paper-light` on it, 5.4:1), nav hover and current page, the FAQ index, a link that books. 5.0:1 on `paper`, 4.6:1 on `sheet`.

tokens.name: coral-pressed
tokens.usage: The coral button under the pointer, and the Meet button's text on its pale wash. `paper-light` on it 7:1.

tokens.name: lilac-pressed
tokens.usage: The lilac button under the pointer (`ink` on it 7.8:1), and the chosen chip in Inês's schedule.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Words that warn, in a darker coral that clears 4.78:1 on the pale Meet wash: 'Meet link missing', a retry in homework, an account error. 5.6:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: booked
tokens.usage: A booked day or lesson on the calendar: `coral` 15% over `paper-light`, the lightest that keeps `ink` above 4.5:1 (9.6:1).

tokens.name: weekly
tokens.usage: A weekly lesson on the calendar: `lavender` 50% over `paper-light`. `ink` 8:1, `lavender-ink` 4.6:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline of every card, field and table (1px), drawn in the lilac. Decorative: 2.1:1 on `paper`, so a control's edge that must be seen uses `ink` at 55% (the outline button, 3.1:1).

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Fainter hairlines inside a card: between a timetable's day columns and hour rows, the principles strip, a list's separators.

tokens.name: outline-edge
tokens.usage: The outline button's 1.5px edge (3.1:1 on `paper`); under the pointer it turns `ink`.

tokens.name: outline-light-edge
tokens.usage: The light outline button's 1.5px edge on blue (4.4:1 on `blue-deep`); under the pointer it turns `paper`.

tokens.name: hover-wash
tokens.usage: What an outline button, a list row or a menu row fills with under the pointer.

tokens.name: lilac-on-blue
tokens.usage: Second lines on the blue booking panel and on the footer (4.6:1 on `blue-deep`).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Beth Ellen, Inês's hand. One weight, 400, set tight (-0.025 to -0.045em). Headings only, never below 1.35rem and never for words someone has to read twice. Sizes are clamps: the value here is the size at 1280px wide.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The home hero's title, `paper` on `blue-deep` with its second word in `lavender` (italic, -0.04em). clamp(2.6rem, 4.8vw, 5.9rem).

styles.name: display-approach
styles.usage: How I teach's title, the biggest words on the site, in `ink`. clamp(3rem, 5.6vw, 6.2rem); clamp(2.6rem, 12vw, 4.4rem) on a phone.

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: Lessons and FAQ titles in `ink`: clamp(2.5rem, 4.6vw, 4.7rem) (Lessons 4.4vw, 4.6rem, line height 1.02). A second line drops 0.4em (`display-second-line`) so descenders clear the capitals below.

styles.name: display-price
styles.usage: A lesson's price on Lessons and prices. clamp(3rem, 4.3vw, 4.3rem); 3rem on a phone.

styles.name: display-booking
styles.usage: Book a Lesson and Your Lessons on the blue booking panel, `paper` on `blue-deep`. clamp(2rem, 3vw, 3.15rem).

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: A section heading inside a page: the FAQ's groups, Lessons' closing line.

styles.name: display-principle
styles.usage: The three principles beside the home hero, in `lavender-ink`. clamp(1.35rem, 1.8vw, 1.75rem): the smallest Beth Ellen anywhere.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Montserrat at 400 for reading, 600 for a title inside a card, 700 for labels. Body is 18px on a laptop and 17px under 560px.

styles.name: hero-lead
styles.sample: One to one, at your pace.
styles.usage: The line under the home title, `paper` on blue. clamp(1.35rem, 2vw, 1.8rem).

styles.name: callout-copy
styles.usage: An editorial callout's words (How I teach).

styles.name: body-copy
styles.sample: We spend the hour on what you need.
styles.usage: Running text everywhere, in `ink`; 17px under 560px.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: A titled item in a list of ideas (How I teach), above `copy-small`.

styles.name: copy-small
styles.sample: Yes, it's very common to feel nervous.
styles.usage: FAQ answers, a principle's line (line height 1.3), a calendar day's number.

styles.name: faq-question
styles.sample: I'm nervous about speaking. Is that normal?
styles.usage: An FAQ question in its row, clamp(1.02rem, 1.25vw, 1.15rem); 1.05rem on a phone.

styles.name: month-title
styles.usage: The month over the booking calendar and Your lessons; 0.92rem in a narrow card.

styles.name: week-title
styles.usage: The week over Inês's timetable, clamp(1.15rem, 2.4vw, 1.55rem); 1rem while she edits her hours.

styles.name: student-name
styles.usage: A student's name on their card in Inês's schedule.

styles.name: next-lesson
styles.usage: Inês's next lesson line; the time in it is 1.1rem at 700.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Small capitals, always `text-transform: uppercase`, tracked wide. They name things and never hold a sentence.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Every `.button`: 0.78rem, 600, 0.19em, uppercase.

styles.name: button-label-compact
styles.usage: `.button--compact`, the supporting pair beside the main action: 0.7rem, 0.14em.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: The header's links and its Booking pill: 0.82rem, 700, 0.14em, uppercase, `blue-deep`, `coral-action` when current or under the pointer.

styles.name: eyebrow-label
styles.usage: `.eyebrow` above a heading or in a card, in `lavender-ink`: 0.78rem, 700, 0.14em.

styles.name: closing-label
styles.usage: The big label in Lessons' closing band, `paper` on blue.

styles.name: footer-label
styles.usage: The footer's links, `paper` on `blue-deep`.

styles.name: legend-label
styles.usage: A booking choice's legend (Lesson, Where, Length) in the booking bar and the change dialog, in `lavender-ink`: 0.64rem. A calendar's weekday names use the same size at 0.06em.

styles.name: tag-label
styles.usage: The smallest tag: `Added` on a lesson Inês added herself, on her next-lesson card and in the timetable (0.58rem).

spacing.note: Named the same in the stylesheet since 9 Nov 2026 (`--gap-hair` to `--gap-section` in globals.css); older rules still write plain rem values and move onto these steps as they are touched. Space separates things; it never fills a gap: a card is as tall as what is in it.

tokens.name: gap-hair
tokens.usage: A small line under its label; tags and translations in a row; a sign-in card's lines.

tokens.name: gap-label
tokens.usage: A field's label above its input; an icon beside its word in a segmented control; a pager's arrows.

tokens.name: gap-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, marks and rates in a row; footer links; a small button's icon.

tokens.name: gap-row
tokens.usage: A title and its pager; facts in a list; a card prompt's lines.

tokens.name: gap-pair
tokens.usage: Two buttons side by side in a bar, an alert or the phone menu.

tokens.name: gap-actions
tokens.usage: A dialog's buttons; Inês's lesson cards in a stack.

tokens.name: gap-list
tokens.usage: Rows in a card's list, menu rows, student cards in a grid.

tokens.name: gap-card
tokens.usage: Parts inside a booking card: the booking bar's choices, the lesson overview, an account card, a student's profile.

tokens.name: gap-block
tokens.usage: Blocks inside a dialog or a calendar; cards in a stack; the header's links.

tokens.name: gap-panel
tokens.usage: Between a card's two halves; Inês's tools header; two of her cards side by side (Time off's month and its card, Profile's two cards); the expressions layout.

tokens.name: gap-wide
tokens.usage: Between the principles, the lesson programme's columns.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between How I teach's items; the header's brand and nav.

radius.note: The few true geometric radii. Everything drawn uses a squiggle instead.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Dots and round controls: a calendar day's booked dot, the timetable's now marker, an avatar's ring.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A count badge (expressions' translations count) and the phone menu's close button.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare: things lift off the paper only while they move or float. Named the same in the stylesheet (globals.css, 9 Nov 2026).

tokens.name: shadow-lift-coral
tokens.usage: A coral button under the pointer, in its own colour.

tokens.name: shadow-lift-blue
tokens.usage: A blue button under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-lift-lilac
tokens.usage: A lilac button under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog lifted off the page (lesson, change, Inês's lesson and student dialogs).

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: The account menu and the phone menu's panel.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The segmented thumb, so the chosen option sits on its track.

squiggle.note: "Thumbprint": one hand scaled to each thing it lands on. Every corner differs from its neighbours, as her splats and lettering do; the smaller the element, the gentler the hand. Use these, never a plain radius, on anything drawn.

tokens.name: squiggle-card
tokens.usage: The biggest surfaces: a lesson product card, the home principles' marks.

tokens.name: squiggle-panel
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs: booking cards, the lesson dialog, a student's card, an alert.

tokens.name: squiggle-button
tokens.usage: Filled buttons (coral, blue, lilac).

tokens.name: squiggle-button-alt
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, mirrored so two buttons in one card are never the same drawing twice.

tokens.name: squiggle-button-shift
tokens.usage: A filled button's cut where the pointer settles: it shifts on `motion-spring` and settles, like wet ink.

tokens.name: squiggle-button-alt-shift
tokens.usage: The outline button's cut under the pointer, and the booking's confirm button's.

tokens.name: squiggle-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles: a calendar day, a lesson in Your lessons, a receipt.

tokens.name: squiggle-tabs
tokens.usage: The tab bar in Inês's schedule and its thumb's track.

tokens.name: squiggle-field
tokens.usage: Fields, times, inner rows and every small raised surface: the most used shape (46 rules).

tokens.name: squiggle-thumb
tokens.usage: The segmented control's sliding thumb.

tokens.name: squiggle-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the header's Booking pill, a status pill, a small button.

tokens.name: squiggle-chip
tokens.usage: Chips: a student's mark, a tag, a count; gentlest, because a radius that reads as character on a button reads as damage on a 40px chip.

layout.note: Plain CSS values the stylesheet declares as variables, or the widths its container queries turn on.

tokens.name: page-pad
tokens.usage: Every page's side padding (1.25rem under 560px). Bands and heroes run full bleed; their content sits inside this.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: One inset for every booking card, so cards side by side (the lesson bar, the calendar, its times, an account card) start their content on one line.

tokens.name: pad-dialog
tokens.usage: One inset for every dialog, the student's and Inês's alike.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The sticky header: 96px up to 1100px, 88px up to 820px (menu behind a toggle), 84px under 560px, 68px on a phone held sideways.

tokens.name: booking-container
tokens.usage: The booking column is a container named `booking`; its layout turns at 520, 700, 900 and 1100px of its own width, never the window's (at 900px a media query once overflowed the confirm step).

tokens.name: student-card-wide
tokens.usage: A student's card (`student-card` container) lays its profile beside the lessons from this width; keep it (accepted 28 Oct 2026). From 58rem it adds a third column; under 30rem everything stacks.

tokens.name: student-grid-min
tokens.usage: The narrowest a student card gets in the Students grid before the grid drops a column.

tokens.name: prose-measure
tokens.usage: The widest a title or a block of reading runs (the home title, terms).

easing.note: Declared in the stylesheet as variables; recorded here, not driven from here.

tokens.name: motion-ease
tokens.usage: The default for anything that changes: colour, opacity, a panel's height.

tokens.name: motion-ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: decelerates hard and long, quick then unhurried (shadows, splats landing).

tokens.name: motion-ease-in-out
tokens.usage: A change of size or place that should carry what it moves: a card growing, the thumb crossing far.

tokens.name: motion-pen
tokens.usage: What is drawn: the editorial rule under a heading, at a pen's pace.

tokens.name: motion-spring
tokens.usage: The soft spring, about 4% give: things that land or travel, a button's cut shifting. A sampled linear() spring where supported.

tokens.name: motion-spring-firm
tokens.usage: The firm spring: controls answering a press (a button's lift, the segmented thumb).

duration.note: Shorter under 720px wide (in brackets). Reduced motion turns movement off and keeps fades.

tokens.name: motion-surface
tokens.usage: A surface's state: a hover fill, a field's focus, a chip chosen (180ms).

tokens.name: motion-route
tokens.usage: A route change's fade between pages (190ms).

tokens.name: motion-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog opening or closing.

tokens.name: motion-page
tokens.usage: A page turning in Inês's schedule's week, the view transition (520ms).

tokens.name: motion-land
tokens.usage: A splat landing on the page, staggered by its order (820ms).
